author: NetworkChuck
description:
Try Flare for free: https://ntck.co/flare-opnsense

Your smart fridge could be the way a hacker gets into your home network. So in part two of Mike's network build, I use OPNsense and VLANs to split his one flat network into separate networks for work, users, and a quarantined IoT network that can't touch anything else. The firewall is the mini PC from Japan we built in part one, the switch is a QNAP I'd never used (it has a dent), and DHCP almost broke me over one hidden checkbox. Then I told Mike his IoT devices were finally locked down, and he asked me what an IoT device is.

In this video you'll learn what a VLAN actually is and how to create one in OPNsense, how trunk (tagged) and untagged ports work on a managed switch, how to give each new network its own gateway IP and DHCP range (plus the one DHCP setting Claude Code had to find for me), how deny-by-default firewall rules and an alias keep your IoT devices locked in their own corner, and what happens when you point an AI agen
title: STOP putting everything on ONE network!!
